rationale: Preserve the released frame-gap contract. Bounded archive recovery replaces an indivisible bulk call with verified per-base transfers, allowing three additional native calls per populated archive input base. Input populations must match the declared fixture; other calls and loans keep the existing work budget. Host gate rejects only material repeatable regressions beyond two observed sample ranges. 1 ms is a materiality floor, not an in-game latency promise. Reference and candidate use the same harness, compiler and host. These reviewable tolerances do not auto-update.
